slots.hair: just pulled out of a high ponytail
slots.outfit: a black sports bra and low-rise cotton trousers with her midriff bare
slots.place: on the floor in front of the full-length mirror in the corner of her own living room, an ice pack on the floor beside her
slots.action: She is sitting cross-legged with her back to the mirror, turned round to the lens, pressing the ice pack to her knee with one hand.
slots.face: Very flat, with a trace of the joke she always makes about her own knees.
slots.light: One floor lamp in the living room is in front of her, the depth of the room is dark and the focus falls off quickly.

slots.hair: a high ponytail being taken down, the mint-green inner layer showing as it falls
slots.outfit: a mint-green fitted sleeveless dance top and black shorts
slots.place: sitting on the edge of her bed at home with her phone propped beside her, a practice video paused on the screen
slots.action: She is scrolling through the three hundred unposted practice videos with one hand and pulling the ponytail out with the other.
slots.face: Her attention is on the phone, not the lens, with a slight frown.
slots.light: The bedside lamp is in front of her and low, and the rest of the room is dark.

slots.hair: wet and just flicked over, the mint-green inner layer showing
slots.outfit: a cool white towel wrapped around her, the line of her shoulders and back showing
slots.place: in her bathroom straight out of the shower, steam on the mirror
slots.action: Her free hand has just flicked the wet hair over so the mint-green underneath shows.
slots.face: Caught mid-flick, her eyes not back to the lens yet.
slots.light: The light above the mirror is directly in front of her and the steam eats the depth of the room.

slots.hair: still in a high ponytail, damp at the temples
slots.outfit: a black midriff-baring dance top and low-rise track trousers, sweat marks at the collarbone and waist
slots.place: on the wooden floor of the Gangnam dance studio after hours, the main lights off and only one lamp beside the mirror wall
slots.action: She is sitting on the wooden floor with her back against the mirror, still breathing hard, the ponytail still tied.
slots.face: Out of breath from finishing, looking straight into the lens without smiling.
slots.light: The one lamp beside the mirror is in front of her, the depth of the studio is black, and the mirror throws one line of light back.

slots.hair: down and a little damp, tucked behind one ear
slots.outfit: a grey cropped hooded jacket left open over a black fitted tank and low-rise trousers
slots.place: at the outdoor seating of a convenience store in Gangnam late at night, straight after teaching
slots.action: She is sitting on the plastic chair outside with a drink in one hand and the ice pack still hooked on her bag.
slots.face: Very tired but laughing, the funny version of her rather than the strict teacher.
slots.light: The light spilling out of the convenience store is in front of her and the street beyond the seating is black.
